notes.title: Update version 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list][*]Modified color of spikes in world 2 to increase visibility.[/*][/list]
Spikes now match the color of the rock walls in world 2, so they stand out more and are less likely to be mistaken for grass.

To Our Fans: We value your feedback. If you encounter an issue or have suggestions, please let us know in the comments section below!

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed bug with 'Die 500 Times' achievement.[/*][/list]

Note: This update is being setup retroactively. The 1.0.1  build actually went live on 04/07/2018

Note: Death count for a particular stage is only counted/saved when you complete the stage. Deaths acquired without completing the stage are discarded and not counted toward your total death count in the stats menu or toward the 'Die 500 times' achievement.

To Our Fans:
We value your feedback. If you encounter an issue or have suggestions, please let us know in the comments section below!
